question.text: The remainder obtained when $1 !+2 !+3 !+\ldots+11 !$ is divided by 12 is

solution.text:
Let $S=1!+2 !+3 !+41+\ldots+11 !$
Here, we see that from $4 !$ to $111,$ we alwars get 12 factor, so it is always divisible by 12
Now. $1 !+2 !+3 !=1+2+6=9$
Hence, when $S$ is divided by $12,$ the remainder is 9.
